_comment: Knob declarations for the generic brief-driven adapter. This list IS the whitelist: the models may
only set knobs that appear here, with values inside the declared type/range/choices. Anything else
is rejected before a command is built, so an incomplete list is safe (just limiting).
Each knob is exported as an environment variable of that name to your test_command.
value_type      int | float | bool | string | enum
category        algorithm | hyperparameter | reward | observation | action |
fidelity_safe   may a fidelity rung set it? (only cost knobs: it must not change the problem)
llm_may_change  may the actor propose it? false = harness/human only
Mark anything that changes what 'solved' means as category 'task_definition': those stay gated
behind the brief's permitted_task_changes even when both models agree. Prefer 'enum' with explicit
choices over free-form 'string' — a string reaches a shell command line.
